requirements.description: Current baseline do_fetch failure names the recipe, missing URI/DL object, and BB_NO_NETWORK=1 without network fallback
The local mirror archive SHA-256 matches the recipe and checksum validation remains enabled
An approved run-local file mirror config has metadata evidence for PREMIRRORS and BB_NO_NETWORK
A new Pi session resumes the same detached job identity and incrementally tails it without duplicate verification
The offline image succeeds with download, package, manifest, rootfs, and image artifact evidence
A second ordinary image build reports sstate/signature reuse and no task reruns
